skeptic.argument: In Node.js v26, `process.stdin.listenerCount("end")` is 1 before any user code runs due to Node internal stream plumbing (`readableOnEnd`), so the regression test for f-0002 should compare `listenerCount("data")` and `listenerCount("end")` before and after `require()`.

builder.argument: Added regression tests in `tests/hooks/config-protection.test.js` covering MultiEdit blocking, `require()` listener count invariance, and `post-edit-typecheck.js` diagnostic matching across root `index.ts`, nested `src/index.ts`, Windows backslashes, Next.js route metacharacters, and diagnostic messages containing `(1,2): `.

dreamer.argument: All 3 must-fix findings now have deterministic regression tests that failed before the fix and pass after the fix.
